name: triangular_loop_inverse_quote_pip_spread_compounded
question_template: A trader starts with USD {NOTIONAL} and runs the loop USD->EUR->GBP->USD. EUR/USD is quoted directly at {EURUSD} USD per EUR, no spread. The EUR-GBP leg is quoted inversely as {EURGBP_INV} EUR per GBP, no spread. GBP/USD has mid {GBPUSD_MID} USD per GBP and a bid-ask width of {SPREAD_PIPS} pips centred on the mid (one pip = USD 0.0001 per GBP); GBP is sold at the bid. A fee of {FEE_BPS} basis points on each of the three trades is deducted from that trade's proceeds in the currency received. Nothing is rounded. The implied cross rate is the USD-per-GBP rate from the first two quotes alone, ignoring fees and spread. A loop's net profit is ending USD minus starting USD, in basis points of that loop's starting balance. The loop runs up to {MAX_LOOPS} times, each reinvesting the previous loop's entire ending USD balance; after each loop, trading continues only if that loop's net profit is at least {HURDLE_BPS} basis points. Report the cumulative net profit over all executed loops in basis points of the original USD {NOTIONAL} (negative for a loss), the implied cross rate, one loop's net profit in basis points, the ending USD balance after the last executed loop, and whether one loop is profitable (net profit above zero).

slots.description: USD per GBP implied by the direct and inverse quotes, before fees
Net profit of one loop in basis points of its starting balance
USD balance held after the last executed loop
Whether a single loop earns strictly positive net profit

program:
from fractions import Fraction

def solve():
    N = Fraction(P["NOTIONAL"])
    A = Fraction(P["EURUSD"])
    B = Fraction(P["EURGBP_INV"])
    M = Fraction(P["GBPUSD_MID"])
    S = Fraction(P["SPREAD_PIPS"])
    f = Fraction(P["FEE_BPS"]) / 10000
    R = int(P["MAX_LOOPS"])
    H = Fraction(P["HURDLE_BPS"])
    if N <= 0 or A <= 0 or B <= 0 or R < 1:
        raise ValueError("inputs must be positive and at least one loop")
    pip = Fraction(1, 10000)
    bid = M - (S / 2) * pip
    if bid <= 0:
        raise ValueError("bid must be positive")
    implied = A * B
    keep = 1 - f
    eur = (N / A) * keep
    gbp = (eur / B) * keep
    usd_after_one = gbp * bid * keep
    g = usd_after_one / N
    loop_bps = (g - 1) * 10000
    loops = R if loop_bps >= H else 1
    ending = N * (g ** loops)
    total_bps = (ending - N) / N * 10000
    profitable = "profitable" if loop_bps > 0 else "unprofitable"
    return {
        "final": total_bps,
        "implied_cross_rate": implied,
        "single_loop_profit_bps": loop_bps,
        "ending_usd_balance": ending,
        "loop_profitable": profitable,
    }
